integration_handoff.mode: Manual copy only; active workbench mounts mountManual, not the draft adapter
integration_handoff.agent_gate: Unchanged: Metadata404/disabled cannot start a new run; owned history remains read-only
integration_handoff.source_integration: Review the exact candidate commit. On f8b, preserve manual mode rather than reactivating serverAdapter/createDraft. No automatic install or source switch.

manual_acceptance_steps: Use an existing authorized article; no new Provider calls required.
Open standalone.html locally, paste article, supply title/digest/cover description separately, prepare and preview.
Click Copy to WeChat; require the rich-copy success message, not plain-text success.
Manually open the designated account backend. Confirm account identity before pasting into its article editor.
Enter title/digest separately; manually upload cover/body images; compare every paragraph, list and table.
Save draft manually, reopen it, record actual retained/lost heading, line-height, emphasis, quote, list and table styles.
Do not label customer E2E PASS until that real editor evidence exists.
observations: The existing fail-closed legacy draft UI remains available for separately authorized integration, but is not mounted by customer entry points.
The offline HTML embeds generated copies of shared source; --check detects stale artifacts, avoiding separately maintained preview/export implementations.
Inline layout and text are browser-tested; WeChat editor filtering is not yet observed and may change styles.
No Runtime, Prompt, Skill, Secret, Guard/Approval, Schema, Migration, server API or deployment changes. Original dirty worktree content is preserved.
